name: IndusInd Bank
narrative: Management reported profit after tax rising to ₹1,037 crore and pre-provision operating profit reaching ₹2,773 crore in Q1 FY27, recovering from Q4 FY26 profit after tax of ₹594 crore. Full-year FY27 loan growth and RoA guidance remain pending.

promises.statement: Management intends to bring Net NPA down into the 0.60%-0.70% range over time.

said.quote: Our intent is to bring down Net NPA well below 1%, in the 60-70 basis points vicinity over a period of time

promises.statement: The bank plans to operate within an LCR range of 115% to 120%.

said.quote: The range, we would operate between 115% to 120%. That's pretty much the range we'll be working within

promises.statement: Management aims to grow loan book in line with the market in FY27.

said.quote: our intent is to grow in line with market in the financial year 2026-2027 and be in the vicinity of 1% ROA as we get to the back end of that year

promises.statement: IndusInd Bank expects FY27 loan growth to be broadly in line with market growth.

said.quote: What I have been talking about over the last couple of quarters is that FY26-27 should see us grow broadly in line with market

promises.statement: FY27 will be a year of calibrated growth rather than book contraction in micro loans.

said.quote: With asset quality stabilizing, FY27 will be a year of calibrated growth rather than book contraction in micro loans

promises.statement: The bank is aiming for a 1% exit Return on Assets in FY27.

said.quote: So, for our journey to 1%, we are looking at that coming in equal contribution, both from the credit cost and from operating profit

promises.statement: Management expects loan growth to be in line with the market growth this year.

said.quote: we will grow in line with market this year with an exit ROA of 1%, and we stand by that

promises.statement: Management aims to reach around 1% ROA by the backend of FY27.

said.quote: our intent is to grow in line with market in the financial year 2026-2027 and be in the vicinity of 1% ROA as we get to the back end of that year

promises.statement: Vehicle finance asset quality outcomes in FY26 are expected to be better than FY25.

said.quote: We expect the trend to continue in Q4 as well resulting in the full year FY26 asset quality outcomes to be better vs. FY25

cash.reason: Not meaningful for a bank: its operating cash flow moves with deposits and loans.

bull.point: Profit after tax showed strong sequential recovery, rising to ₹1,037 crore in Q1 FY27 from ₹594 crore in Q4 FY26.

evidence.quote: As a result, the profit after tax for the quarter was at Rs.594 crores vs Rs.128 crores QoQ
As a result, profit after tax improved sharply to Rs.1,037 crore from Rs.594 crore in the previous quarter

bull.point: Pre-provision operating profit grew 21% quarter-on-quarter to ₹2,773 crore in Q1 FY27.

evidence.quote: Pre-provision operating profit stood at Rs.2,773 crore growing 8% YoY and 21% QoQ

bull.point: Home loan portfolio expanded 45% year-on-year to reach ₹6,510 crore in Q4 FY26.

evidence.quote: Our home loan book maintained robust momentum with outstanding at Rs.6,510 crores growing 45% YoY and 6% QoQ

bear.point: Auditors highlighted an Emphasis of Matter concerning accounting of derivatives, interest and fee income, and internal control enhancements.

evidence.quote: explains the status of matters related to accounting of derivatives, interest and fee income and other assets and other liabilities and subsequent steps to strengthen the systems, process and related controls

bear.point: The statutory auditors drew attention to a qualified opinion issued by the auditor of a subsidiary company.

evidence.quote: refers to the qualified opinion issued by the auditor of the subsidiary

bear.point: The bank maintains large contingent liabilities totaling ₹11,72,712.68 crore at the end of FY26.
